A paladin order in radiant white-and-gold winged plate, bearing blazing sunforged warhammers and tower shields emblazoned with the risen sun, clashing against a vast skeleton legion in tarnished black bone-armor, wielding rusted scythes under torn death-banner standards.

A high-elven host in luminous silver filigree plate with crescent-moon helms, loosing starfire arrows from enchanted bows, meeting a shadow-armored dark-elven warhost in spiked obsidian plate bearing twin curved shadow-blades and inverted black moon heraldry.

A dwarven shield-wall in rune-etched gold plate and great horned helms, braced with axes blazing orange runic fire, against towering cave-trolls swinging chained boulder-flails and a green orc horde flooding a torch-lit mountain pass.

A dragon-riding kingdom in crimson-and-black scaled plate with horned drake helms, mounted on roaring war-dragons, descending upon an orc warhost in crude spiked iron wielding enormous black-iron mauls under screaming skull-banner standards.

A fae-elven cavalry in shimmering moonsilver armor with butterfly-wing crests, riding silver stags and wielding lances of living thorn-wood, charging a shrieking swarm of goblin wolf-riders in patchwork leather bearing jagged bone flags.

Men of the frozen north in fur-trimmed iron plate with great antlered helms, swinging two-handed runed axes under bear-skull banners, standing defiant against a demon legion in smoldering black plate with curling horn crests and flame-wreathed blades.

A wizard-led host with battle-mages in deep-blue robes over enchanted violet plate, unleashing arcane bolt-staffs and runed siege-wands, against a necromancer's risen dead — rotting armored wights and shambling bone-giants under green-flame lantern standards.

A besieged fantasy garrison of men in battered silver plate with gryphon-crest helms, holding runed ballistae along shattered walls, against a monstrous invading host of giants, trolls, and orcs bearing siege-towers crowned with grinning iron skulls.

A sylvan wood-elf warhost in bark-and-leaf enchanted armor with stag-antler helms, wielding singing recurve bows and vine-wrapped longswords under green-canopy banners, clashing with a gnoll horde in hyena-pelt and jagged bronze, swinging bone-hafted cleaver-axes.

A dwarven runepriest brotherhood in deep-bronze layered plate with forge-flame crest helms, hurling blazing runic hammers, standing against a tide of subterranean deep-orcs in jagged obsidian scale-mail, wielding enormous pick-axes under blinded-eye black standards.

A halfling militia in bright copper-inlaid splint-mail with acorn-crest helms, wielding oversized enchanted slings and short rune-blades under hearthfire banners, desperately holding a river crossing against a goblin warband in rusted chain swinging hooked iron flails.

A sea-elven host in coral-and-pearl plate with crested wave helms, riding giant seahorses and wielding trident-lances crackling with storm-lightning, meeting a sahuagin raider legion in sharkbone armor bearing serrated greatswords under bloodred shark-jaw standards.

A centaur heavy cavalry in gilded half-plate with sunburst crest helms, charging with enchanted greatspears and crescent moon shields, crashing into a minotaur warhost in brutal black iron plate wielding towering double-bladed axes under bull-skull heraldry.

A gnomish artificer army in brass-and-copper clockwork plate with goggled helm crests, piloting arcane steam-war-golems and wielding spark-cannon staves, meeting a hobgoblin iron-discipline legion in dark-red lacquered plate bearing serrated glaives under iron-fist standards.

A tiefling infernal knight order in deep-crimson ornate plate with swept-back swept-horn helms, bearing hellfire-edged greatswords, clashing with a celestial aasimar host in blinding white-gold plate with great feathered wing-crest helms wielding radiant war-lances.

A lizardfolk swamp-host in hammered copper scale-plate adorned with serpent crests, wielding massive jade-tipped spears and runed obsidian clubs under feathered serpent banners, clashing with a yuan-ti sorcerer-army in gilded snake-scale plate casting venom-lightning from jade staves.

An undead vampire knighthood in matte-black ornate plate with great bat-wing helms, riding skeletal warhorses and wielding darkness-drinking lances, descending upon a holy order of clerics in sunburst-embossed white plate wielding radiant hammer-maces under golden dawn banners.

A giant-kin warband of stone giants in jagged granite plate with mountain-peak horn helms, hurling rune-carved boulder-hammers, meeting a frost-elven host in icy crystalline armor with snowflake crest helms, wielding blizzard-enchanted glaives under white wolf standards.

A desert kingdom of bronze-armored djinn-touched warriors in ornate swept-blade crest helms, wielding flame-scimitar blades and enchanted sandstorm shields under golden phoenix banners, clashing with a scorpion-rider gnoll horde in bone-and-chitin plate bearing giant poison-tipped lances.

A kingdom of beastfolk — lion-maned leonin warriors in engraved amber plate with great mane-crest helms, wielding runed two-handed swords under roaring lion-head standards, tearing into a hyena-gnoll warhost in jagged rust-iron wielding barbed chain-whips.

A human ranger-kingdom in dark-green enchanted scale-armor with hawk-wing crest helms, wielding twin runed hunting-blades and silverwood longbows under eagle-and-moon banners, holding a forest border against a trollborn warhost of feral trolls in crude stone-studded hide-armor.

An order of dragonborn paladins in iridescent scale-plate with swept-fang helm crests, wielding enormous rune-etched greatswords crackling with lightning, meeting a chromatic dragon-cult horde of kobolds in crude draconic iron-plate bearing enormous black crossbows under claw-mark scarlet banners.

A hobbit-shire militia in polished bronze ringmail with floral-carved helm crests, wielding enchanted short-swords and runed sling-staffs under hearthsmoke-and-oak banners, desperately repelling a black-orc raiding warband in heavy jagged plate swinging oversized serrated cleavers.

A moon-elven arcane knighthood in flowing pale-silver plate with crescent-and-star crested helms, wielding void-touched runed longswords and starfire lances under silver crescent banners, obliterating a chaos-demon warhost in melted-looking spiked black plate wielding flame-vomiting greataxes.

A mountain kingdom's ironclad gryphon-riders in sable-and-gold ornate plate with great gryphon-wing crests, swooping with shock-lances of enchanted ironwood, colliding above the battlefield with an orcish wyvern-rider warhost in jagged black iron under screaming wyvern-skull red standards.
